title: Immune : Improving Safety Against Jailbreaks in Multi-modal LLMs via Inference-Time Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of multimodal jailbreak prompts designed to bypass safety filters and elicit hate speech or racist content (e.g., anti-Asian sentiment) using benchmarks like MM-SafetyBench and JailbreakV-28K.
